summary: All three forbidden hyphen positions are exercised as separate fixtures through the real parseSpec — '-scrollback' (leading), 'scrollback-' (trailing), 'codex--scrollback' (doubled) — each asserting rule REQ-011.1.4 with a per-case failure message, so an implementation catching only one or two disjuncts fails; the legal single-internal-hyphen stem is asserted violation-free elsewhere in the same file.
